# telnyx_agent_gateway_guardrail (Resource)

A guardrail on an Agent Gateway, a check that requests and responses pass through.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_agent_gateway_guardrail" "pii" {
  gateway_id = telnyx_agent_gateway.example.id
  name       = "pii"
  type       = "content_filter"
  modes      = ["before_request"]

  settings_wo = jsonencode({
    patterns = [{ name = "email", action = "mask" }]
  })
  settings_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.
- `modes` (Set of String) When the guardrail runs.
- `name` (String) What a request names in its `guardrails` field.
- `type` (String) The kind of check. It cannot change after create. One of `azure_content_safety`, `bedrock`, `content_filter`, `custom_code`, `lakera`, `model_judge`, `presidio`, `tool_permission`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `always_on` (Boolean) Whether it runs on every request.
- `settings_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The type's settings. `content_filter`: `patterns` (prebuilt patterns by name, such as `us_ssn` or `email`), `regexes`, `keywords`, and `categories` (such as `prompt_injection`), each with an `action` of `block` or `mask`. `tool_permission`: `rules` (`id`, `tool_name`, `tool_type`, `decision`, `argument_patterns`), a `default` decision, and `on_denied` (`block` or `rewrite`). `model_judge`: a `model` on the instance and weighted `criteria` (`name`, `description`, `weight`, the weights summing to 100). `custom_code`: `code` defining `apply_guardrail(inputs, request_data, input_type)`. `lakera`: `api_key`, `project_id`, `api_base`. `presidio`: `analyzer_url`, `anonymizer_url`, `entities` (entity name to `block` or `mask`), `language`. `bedrock`: `guardrail_id`, `version`, `region`, and `access_key_id` with `secret_access_key`, or `role_name`. `azure_content_safety`: `api_key`, `endpoint`, `severity` (0 to 7). Provider secrets are write-only. Responses leave the secrets out. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`. Write-only: never stored in state. Change `settings_wo_version` to send a new value.
- `settings_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send `settings_wo` again; Terraform cannot detect a change to a value it does not store.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Identifies the guardrail.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_agent_gateway_guardrail.pii <gateway_id>/<id>
```
